title: Steady 30s Google Flow script
howToShoot: Generate three clips in order. Paste the identical sharedSettings.promptBlock at the top of every prompt. Use Ingredients on every clip. Scene 2 must start from Scene 1 last frame. Scene 3 must start from Scene 2 last frame. Same voice, same music, same cafe, same phone, same owner in every clip so it plays as one continuous video.

flowProject.mode: Ingredients to Video, then Frames to Video / Scene Builder
flowProject.outputLengthNote: Flow generates about 8 seconds per clip. Generate the 8-second prompt, then Extend 2 seconds with the matching extendPrompt so each scene is 10 seconds. Do not change settings, voice, or music on the extend.
ingredients: Owner: woman, early 30s, olive skin, dark hair in a low bun, small gold hoops, white tee, black cafe apron, calm focused face
Phone: modern black smartphone showing Steady, warm beige UI, dark text, rounded gold buttons, serif Steady wordmark
Cafe: small daylight cafe, beige walls, wood counter, pastry case soft in background, warm morning light

sharedSettings.promptBlock: VERTICAL 9:16, photoreal cinematic product commercial, one continuous shot language. SAME CHARACTER every frame: a restaurant owner, woman, early 30s, olive skin, dark hair in a low bun, small gold hoop earrings, white t-shirt, black cafe apron. SAME LOCATION every frame: her small cafe at the counter, warm beige interior, wood, soft morning window light from camera left, shallow depth of field, background slightly creamy. SAME PROP every frame: the same black smartphone in her hands, screen showing the Steady app, warm beige background, dark ink text, rounded gold tan buttons, serif Steady logo, clean minimal UI, no clutter. CAMERA: handheld-stable, 35mm look, slow gentle push-in, never whip pan, never crash zoom. LIGHTING: warm morning key from camera left, soft fill, no neon, no blue tech glow. GRADE: warm beige and gold, like the Steady brand, filmic, clean, not HDR, not cyberpunk. AUDIO BED MUST MATCH THE PREVIOUS CLIP EXACTLY: quiet cafe ambience, distant espresso machine hiss, soft cup clink, low warm acoustic percussion at 95 BPM under the voice, no new melody, no bass drop. VOICE MUST MATCH THE PREVIOUS CLIP EXACTLY: one warm female American narrator, mid 30s, close dry mic, confident, direct, slightly low, speaking to a business owner, no second voice, no robot voice, no reverb change. Do not show pricing, plans, Stripe, Square, QuickBooks, notification banners, remaining-question counters, or a settings dashboard.
sharedSettings.negativePrompt: pricing page, dollar amounts for plans, Square logo, QuickBooks logo, notification bell, daily briefing dashboard, JSON code, admin panel, stock smiling influencer, neon UI, dark mode, ChatGPT purple, messy notifications, extra fingers, warped phone screen text, different woman, different cafe, different phone, new music, new narrator

voice.rule: Do not change this voice between scenes. Do not add a second speaker.

sound.ambience: quiet cafe, distant espresso, soft cup clink
sound.music: low warm acoustic percussion, 95 BPM, continuous bed, no reset
sound.sfx: soft keyboard taps, one gold-button click, one send whoosh
sound.rule: Same bed in all 3 clips. Music does not restart at each cut. Only a tiny gold stinger in the last 1 second of scene 3.

continuousVoiceover.note: This is one 30-second narration. Do not restart the energy at each scene. Leave space. Do not fill every second with words.
continuousVoiceover.full: A bad review just hit your restaurant. Open Steady. Pick Restaurant. Type it like you'd say it. Get the script. One clear next move. Talk it out. Drop in a receipt. Send it to your team. Ask Steady. It's free.

byScene.scene1: A bad review just hit your restaurant. Open Steady. Pick Restaurant.
byScene.scene2: Type it like you'd say it. Get the script. One clear next move.
byScene.scene3: Talk it out. Drop in a receipt. Send it to your team. Ask Steady. It's free.

continuity.scene1LastFrame: Extreme close-up of the same phone. Restaurant / Food and Beverage is selected. Her thumb has just tapped the gold Create account button. Cafe bokeh behind the phone.
continuity.scene2FirstFrame: Continue from that exact phone and hands. The chat screen is now open on the same phone, same cafe, same lighting. No jump in wardrobe or location.
continuity.scene2LastFrame: Phone screen held steady, Steady chat answer visible, gold line reading Next move: Reply today before the dinner rush.
continuity.scene3FirstFrame: Same phone, same hands, same cafe. Start on that Next move line, then the composer tools become visible below it.
continuity.scene3LastFrame: Phone lowers slightly. Clean beige end card: Steady wordmark, Your business co-pilot, Ask Steady. It's free.
